messages:
Marisa (CS): Heads-up — starting 09:12 PT we saw a spike in onboarding webhook failures for ~12 tenants; customers reporting delayed provisioning and some 502s. Anyone oncall?

Ben (CS Manager): I saw the alert. Escalating to eng. Can we get a short customer-facing status asap?

Aaron (Eng): On it. Quick triage: LB shows upstream 502s from onboarding-worker. Suspect queue saturation + retry storms. Pasting a snippet from worker logs: 
```
ERR 2026-03-20T09:13:14Z onboarding-worker: upstream 502 Bad Gateway - backend queue full - retries=3 tenant_id=acct_9a3
```

Priya (Onboarding Eng): Adding color — we had two concurrent batch imports plus several customers retrying webhooks rapidly. Outbound webhook queue hit our soft threshold and backpressured, causing a small retry loop. Throttled at 09:20 PT which reduced load.

Marisa (CS): Thanks. Need a two-part comms plan: 1) quick status to affected customers, 2) follow-up RCA + remediation + credit offer. I'll draft.

Ben (CS Manager): Please include: impact window, what we mitigated, what we’re doing next (fix + credit), and an offered live enablement slot. Keep it short.

Marisa (CS): Draft for review: 
"Hi — we’re reaching out about intermittent onboarding delays you may have seen today between ~09:12–09:45 PT. Root cause: delivery retries + queue saturation on our webhook subsystem during batch imports. Mitigation: we applied throttling and a dedup/backoff fix; provisioning should be back to normal. We’ll follow up with a full RCA and provide a one-time account credit and an optional 1:1 onboarding session to make up for any disruption. Reply if you want a session and preferred times. — Marisa, Customer Success"

Aaron (Eng): Quick technical update — rolled a safe hotfix at 09:45 PT: added dedup of concurrent webhook payloads and exponential backoff on retries. Deployed to onboarding-worker v2.1.4. Error rate fell to ~0.5% by 09:52 PT. Monitoring dashboards: https://dash.redwood/example/onboard-webhooks (internal)

Sam (IncidentBot): Incident created: INC-20260320-47 — severity: P2 — assigned to Aaron, Priya.

Priya (Onboarding Eng): Next steps for CS ops: I can compile the list of impacted tenants and a suggested list of 1:1 slots (30m blocks) for today + tomorrow. Also will attach a short survey link for feedback capture after sessions.

Ben (CS Manager): Credit calc: propose 1 day of service credit for directly impacted accounts, escalate larger credits for customers who missed critical go-live windows. I’ll draft the credit language for approvals.

Marisa (CS): Action items and owners: 
- Aaron: postmortem + permanent fix timeline (action: add queue guardrail + dedupe upstream)
- Priya: impacted tenant list + schedule for enablement sessions + survey link
- Ben: customer comms (send status now) + credits approval flow
- Marisa: outreach and follow-up RCA
Please update this thread when you have ETA.

Aaron (Eng): ETA: postmortem doc by EOD today, patch to add telemetry and automatic throttling thresholds by 48h.

Priya (Onboarding Eng): Impacted tenant list ready, sharing offline via secure doc. Suggested 1:1 slots: 10:30, 11:30, 14:00 PT today; 09:00–16:00 PT tomorrow. Feedback survey (short): https://forms.redwood/onboard-feedback (internal)

Ben (CS Manager): I’ll send the status update now to the list and include the credit + scheduling options. Draft includes the message Marisa wrote + link to schedule and survey.

Marisa (CS): Please include a line offering priority API support while we confirm everything. Also tag renewal-risk accounts for follow-up.

Ben (CS Manager): Will do. Sending first batch at 10:05 PT to impacted accounts. Posting copy here when sent.

Marisa (CS): Thanks — once sent, set a reminder for 24h to nudge customers who haven’t scheduled. Also collect any feedback to feed back into the postmortem.

Aaron (Eng): Confirmed: telemetry shows backlog cleared and retry spikes resolved. Happy to join any customer calls for technical Q&A.

Priya (Onboarding Eng): Adding runbook update to handle burst imports: add temporary per-tenant rate-limiter and clearer alerting for retry storms.

Ben (CS Manager): :thumbsup: Good work. After the RCA we should propose a long-term mitigation (queue autoscaling + exportable backpressure metrics) in the roadmap.

Marisa (CS): Approved. Closing loop here — please keep updates to this thread only. I’ll post the customer-facing sent copy in 10m.

Sam (IncidentBot): Incident updated INC-20260320-47 -> status: mitigated (09:52 PT).
